verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes a documented JMAP API at api.fastmail.com with API-token and Bearer auth, so scripts and services can query, fetch and send mail over HTTP without the UI. The evidence covers raw protocol access only, not guidance for headless or CI use. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless client, CI/automation-specific docs or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The JMAP session resource can be found at https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session
Standard OAuth 2.0 or Bearer tokens. No custom auth protocol to implement.
POST a `methodCalls` array. Query, fetch, and send, all in one HTTP request.
